tail:
number of male contestants:**

    $$ \text{Number of Males} = \text{Total} - \text{Number of Females} $$
    $$ \text{Number of Males} = 18 - 6 = 12 $$

    $$ \text{Number of Males} = 18 \times \frac{2}{3} = 12 $$

Therefore, there are 12 male contestants.

\boxed{12}
